fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Alliance No.2', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Filled buttons, hero canvas, primary text on light surfaces — near-black with a barely-there green undertone that links it to the mint accent without announcing itself

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, nav background

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: Hairline borders, icon strokes, sharpest outlines — provides the crispest edge against white surfaces

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary body text, subdued borders — the middle voice between Obsidian and Ash

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Hairline dividers, accordion separators, disabled and inactive states

palette.name: Neon Mint
palette.role: Highlight section backgrounds, stat callout fills, wireframe geometry accents — the single chromatic moment that makes the brand instantly recognizable
